nodes.title: 动漫、CG四视图提示词
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
  图片 1: 角色参考图之一，同一角色，面部五官、发型、瞳色、表情等样貌细节以此图为准。
  图片 2: 角色参考图之二，同一角色，身材比例、服装款式、配色、配饰、鞋履等设定细节以此图为准。
  以上所有参考图为同一角色，全片角色的画风、面部特征、发型、身材比例、服装、配饰必须与参考图严格一致，不新增、不替换参考图中已明确呈现的任何设定元素。

summary:
  2秒 9:16 竖屏，纯色浅灰背景，均匀打光。以 subject_definitions 中参考图的角色为唯一主角，四个镜头各0.5秒，以硬切（直接跳切、无任何转场渐变）依次呈现该角色的人脸特写、正面全身、侧面全身、背面全身，构成标准角色设定四视图。每个镜头内角色完全静止、呈直立设定姿势（A-pose式自然站姿）、相机锁死，无推拉升降、无运动模糊。全片画风、线条、上色方式与参考图完全一致。

retention_analysis:
  subject_definitions 中全部参考图共同锁定角色设定：人脸参考决定五官画法、发型与瞳色，是全片一致性锚点；含全身的参考决定头身比、服装版型与配色方案；侧面参考决定发型层次与身体轮廓。参考图中未覆盖的视角与部位（如未提供背面参考时的发型后侧、服装背部印花与结构），由模型基于已提供参考图的同一角色设定合理推断补齐，推断结果必须与已提供参考图在画风、配色、服装结构上自洽，不得引入与参考图冲突的新设定。

detailed_description:
  0-0.5s: 人脸特写。构图取胸部以上，角色面部正对镜头，五官、发型、瞳色、表情严格以参考图为准；眼神正视；机位正面平拍、固定不动；浅灰纯色背景；画面完全静止，无任何运动。
  0.5-1.0s: 硬切至正面全身。角色全身入画，直立设定姿势、双臂自然下垂或按参考图姿态，全身服装、配色、配饰、鞋履严格以参考图为准；机位正面、全身竖构图、固定不动；浅灰纯色背景；画面完全静止。
  1.0-1.5s: 硬切至侧面全身。角色侧身90度直立，发型层次、身体轮廓、服装侧面结构严格以参考图为准；机位侧向、全身竖构图、固定不动；浅灰纯色背景；画面完全静止。
  1.5-2.0s: 硬切至背面全身。角色背对镜头直立，发型后侧、服装背部结构以参考图为准并与其余视角自洽；机位背面、全身竖构图、固定不动；浅灰纯色背景；画面完全静止至结束。

overall_soundscape:
  每次硬切瞬间一声清脆的电子提示音（共4次）；极轻的空间底噪；无对白、无人声、无环境杂音。

non_diegetic_music:
  极简电子氛围，C大调，60 BPM，无人声，音量极低近乎垫底，2秒结尾处干净淡出收束。

negative_constraints:
  禁止镜头推拉摇移；禁止角色动作、眨眼外的任何运动；禁止运动模糊；禁止转场渐变、淡入淡出、叠化；禁止四视图之间的旋转过渡动画；禁止写实化、真人化渲染（参考图为动漫/CG画风时必须保持原画风，不得漂移为写实照片质感）；禁止2D与3D风格混用；禁止改变参考图中角色的头身比、发型、瞳色、服装与配饰；禁止多余肢体、手指数量错误；禁止画面崩坏、五官错位。

nodes.title: 动物四视图提示词
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
  图片 1: 动物参考图之一，同一动物个体，毛色、斑纹、面部特征、体型等外观细节以此图为准。
  图片 2: 动物参考图之二，同一动物个体，身体结构、毛色分布、四肢与尾部细节以此图为准。
  以上所有参考图为同一动物个体，全片动物的物种特征、毛色、斑纹、体型必须与参考图严格一致，不新增、不替换参考图中已明确呈现的任何外观元素。

summary:
  2秒 9:16 竖屏，纯色浅灰摄影棚背景，柔光均匀打亮。以 subject_definitions 中参考图的动物为唯一主角，四个镜头各0.5秒，以硬切（直接跳切、无任何转场渐变）依次呈现该动物的头部特写、正面全身、侧面全身、背面全身，构成标准动物四视图。每个镜头内动物完全静止、呈自然站姿、相机锁死，无推拉升降、无运动模糊。

retention_analysis:
  subject_definitions 中全部参考图共同锁定动物身份：头部参考决定面部五官、耳朵形态与斑纹细节，是全片一致性锚点；含全身的参考决定体型比例、四肢长度、毛色分布与尾巴形态；侧面参考决定躯干厚度与背部线条。参考图中未覆盖的视角与身体部位（如未提供背面参考时的背部斑纹与尾部后侧），由模型基于已提供参考图的同一个体特征合理推断补齐，推断结果必须符合该物种的真实解剖结构，且与已提供参考图在毛色、斑纹走向、体型上自洽，不得引入与参考图冲突的新元素。

detailed_description:
  0-0.5s: 头部特写。构图取肩颈以上，动物面部正对镜头，五官、耳形、斑纹、毛发质感严格以参考图为准；眼神自然正视；机位正面平拍、固定不动；浅灰纯色背景；画面完全静止，无任何运动。
  0.5-1.0s: 硬切至正面全身。动物全身入画，自然站立姿态，四肢与躯干对称舒展，毛色、斑纹、体型严格以参考图为准；机位正面、全身竖构图、固定不动；浅灰纯色背景；画面完全静止。
  1.0-1.5s: 硬切至侧面全身。动物侧身90度自然站立，躯干轮廓、背线、腿长与尾巴自然下垂或舒展，严格以参考图为准；机位侧向、全身竖构图、固定不动；浅灰纯色背景；画面完全静止。
  1.5-2.0s: 硬切至背面全身。动物背对镜头自然站立，背部毛色、斑纹走向与尾部后侧以参考图为准并与其余视角自洽；机位背面、全身竖构图、固定不动；浅灰纯色背景；画面完全静止至结束。

overall_soundscape:
  每次硬切瞬间一声清脆的相机快门声（共4次）；极轻的摄影棚空间底噪；动物极轻微的呼吸声与毛发摩擦声；无对白、无人声、无叫声。

non_diegetic_music:
  极简氛围电子，C大调，60 BPM，无人声，音量极低近乎垫底，2秒结尾处干净淡出收束。

negative_constraints:
  禁止镜头推拉摇移；禁止动物动作、呼吸起伏与眨眼外的任何运动；禁止运动模糊；禁止转场渐变、淡入淡出、叠化；禁止四视图之间的旋转过渡动画；禁止拟人化表情与拟人化姿态；禁止多余或缺失的肢体（多腿、缺腿、双尾、多余耳朵）；禁止解剖结构错误；禁止塑料感、CG渲染感皮毛；禁止改变参考图中动物的物种、毛色、斑纹与体型。

nodes.title: 真实人像四视图提示词-（正半身、右半身、背全身、正全身）
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the single person in every shot, combining all attributes below into one person. Her facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, and makeup are exactly those of the woman in <Picture 1>, <Picture 3> is a reference image showing the person completely naked, with additional angle and expression views of the same face provided by <Picture 4>, <Picture 5>, and <Picture 6>. <Picture 1> and <Pictures 4-6> serve her face and hairstyle only. Her complete outfit — every garment, accessory, and pair of shoes — is worn exactly as shown in <Picture 2>: identical style, colors, patterns, fabrics, and every visible detail, unchanged in all four shots. Her body proportions match the fit of the outfit as shown in <Picture 2>. Face and hair always come from <Picture 1>; outfit, accessories, footwear, and proportions always come from <Picture 2>; together they form this one person.

summary:
[reference generation] A 2-second 9:16 vertical video on a plain light-grey studio background with soft, even lighting; this same studio background is the only setting in all four shots. <Subject 1> is the sole subject: her face and hairstyle follow <Picture 1>, and her Body shape follows <Picture 3>; she appears in the first three shots; she wears the complete outfit of <Picture 2> in all four shots. Four 0.5-second shots joined by hard cuts, in order: a front half-body chest-up portrait, a three-quarter side half-body view, a back full-body view, and a front neck-down full-body view with the head cropped out above the neck. The subject is completely still in each shot, the camera is locked off, the image is sharp and clear with accurate color, in a clean portrait-photography look, Non-existent clothing items are prohibited.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): preserved — the face, hairstyle, skin tone, and makeup of <Picture 1> (reinforced by <Pictures 4-6>) and the body of <Picture 3> are fully kept and anchor the identity in Shots 1-3; the outfit, accessories, and footwear of <Picture 2> are fully kept and worn unchanged in every shot. In [Shot 4] the head is cropped out above the neck, so continuity in that shot is carried entirely by the outfit and proportions of <Picture 2>. Views not covered by the references (back of the hairstyle, back of the outfit) are completed consistently with the references in style, color, and material.

detailed_description:
A clean, sharp portrait-photography look with accurate color, soft even studio lighting, and the same plain light-grey background in all four shots.
[Shot 1] A front half-body chest-up portrait of <Subject 1>, framed from the chest up, both shoulders fully in frame, facing the camera directly. The facial features, hairstyle, and expression follow <Picture 1>; the eyes look straight into the lens. From the chest up she wears the outfit of <Picture 2>, identical in every detail. Locked-off front camera at eye level. The frame is completely still.
[Shot 2] At 00:00.500, a hard cut to a three-quarter side half-body view of <Subject 1>, turned about 45 degrees to the side, framed from the chest up. The side facial contour and hairstyle follow <Picture 1>. The clothing visible is the same outfit of <Picture 2> seen from the side. The gaze looks naturally to the side, away from the camera. Locked-off side camera at eye level. The frame is completely still.
[Shot 3] At 00:01.000, a hard cut to a back full-body view of <Subject 1>, standing upright with her back to the camera and arms hanging naturally. The back of the hairstyle follows <Picture 1>. The outfit is the same garment set of <Picture 2> shown from the back, its back details consistent with its front in style, color, and material. Locked-off back camera, full-body vertical framing. The frame is completely still.
[Shot 4] At 00:01.500, a hard cut to a front neck-down full-body view of <Subject 1>. The frame begins at mid-neck: everything above the neck stays outside the frame, while the neckline, shoulders, torso, arms, hands, hips, legs, and footwear are fully in frame. She stands upright in a natural pose, one hand resting on the waist, the other arm hanging naturally. The full outfit, accessories, and footwear are exactly those of <Picture 2>, the same as in the previous three shots, with body proportions matching the garment's fit as shown in <Picture 2>. Locked-off front camera, vertical framing from the neck down to the feet. The frame is completely still until the end.

overall_soundscape:
A crisp camera shutter click at each of the four hard cuts; extremely quiet studio room tone; very subtle fabric rustle from the subject's clothing; no dialogue, no vocals.

non_diegetic_music:
Minimal ambient electronic in C major at 60 BPM, no vocals, extremely low volume, with a clean fade-out at the end of the 2-second video.
